functional_requirement: an optimistic UI update that rolls back on failure

spec.implementation_rules: implement locally; no undocumented or external component imports; 21st.dev used as visual reference only
spec.accessibility: Ensure keyboard navigation is supported for all interactive elements. Use aria-labels and roles where appropriate. Respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling animations when the user has it enabled.
spec.responsive_behavior: At sm, testimonials are stacked vertically with minimal spacing. At md, they form a two-column layout. At lg, they adopt a staggered three-column layout.
acceptance_criteria: Testimonials are displayed in a staggered layout with names, titles, and quote snippets visible initially.
On hover, the full text of each testimonial is revealed with a smooth transition effect.
A temporary 'saved' state is shown when a testimonial is updated, which reverts to its original state with a visual ripple effect if the backend rejects the change.
Scrolling triggers the staggered reveal of testimonials using useInView and AnimatePresence manages exit animations.
The UI maintains a consistent rhythm during transitions, with layoutId tracking cards and parallax effects on pastel accent highlights.
